quote.message: Fictional quote request written for Confam testing.

expectations.statement: A valid quote request is accepted.
After 5 quote requests from one visitor within a minute, a 6th is refused with "Too many requests", even if the function restarts in between.
A visitor cannot avoid the 5-per-minute limit by changing forwarding headers.
Quote requests rejected for invalid input do not count toward the 5-per-minute spam limit.
When the recent-request count cannot be checked, further quote requests are refused rather than accepted without limit.
